name: radia-jama
description: Read Jama requirements and update existing item fields with explicit confirmation.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to your own Jama Connect account. Search projects and requirements, read item fields and picklists, and prepare field updates for your approval. Ask Claude to list your Jama projects to check the connection. Updates require a before/after preview and your explicit confirmation in a subsequent message. This extension does not include standards documents, RAG, Jira, Confluence, or GENESYS.

jama_base_url.title: Jama URL
jama_base_url.description: Your organization's Jama instance root, such as https://yourorg.jamacloud.com. Do not include /rest or an item URL. Your computer must be able to reach it; connect to your company VPN if required.

jama_client_id.title: Your Jama OAuth client ID
jama_client_id.description: Your own Jama API client ID, not your email address. Ask your Jama administrator if you do not have API credentials.

jama_client_secret.title: Your Jama OAuth client secret
jama_client_secret.description: Your own Jama API client secret, not your Jama password. Claude stores this as sensitive configuration; do not paste it into a conversation.

tools.name: jama_list_projects
tools.description: List accessible Jama projects and check your connection.

tools.name: jama_search
tools.description: Search Jama requirements and other items.

tools.name: jama_get_children
tools.description: Read children of a Jama container.

tools.name: jama_get_relationships
tools.description: Read paginated upstream or downstream Jama traceability links.

tools.name: jama_get_item_type
tools.description: Read real field definitions for an item type.

tools.name: jama_prepare_field_update
tools.description: Preview requested field changes without writing.

tools.name: jama_confirm_field_update
tools.description: Write a prepared update after explicit user approval.
